payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each query, count elements in [l,r] less than a[x]; if l+cnt == x then after sorting the subsegment the element remains unchanged.
payload.rationale: The solution avoids actual sorting but uses a property of sorting: an element's new position is l + count of smaller elements in range. This is a sorting-related optimization, best matching sorting_custom_key among candidates. Other subtypes involve binary search or sweep line which are absent.
